correctness.rationale: For q>=3 pairwise distinct cyclic run letters, each directed adjacent-letter transition occurs at exactly one phase per primitive period. A mixed border cannot recur with positive displacement smaller than the period. For n<=p, closed factors are unary powers and unique balanced-fringe complete returns around a full set of other runs, giving the first indicator sum. For p<n<=2p, starting phases with the length-h period border containing a transition contribute min(a_i,h-1), while a unique balanced constant-border phase occurs precisely when a_i>=h and a_i congruent h mod 2. For n>2p, the length n-p period border has a transition and exactly the two endpoint occurrences, hence all p phases close. Distinct phases are distinct for n>=p. An independent border-enumeration test checked 7533 parameter/length cases; the proof covers unbounded lengths and all permitted run vectors.
